agent-autopilot 1.0.0 – initial release

- Introduces a self-driving agent workflow with heartbeat-driven task execution
- Provides day/night progress reporting rules and templates
- Implements regular long-term memory consolidation with customizable schedule
- Full integration with todo-management skill for task tracking and status updates
- Includes detailed instructions, lifecycle, report formats, and initialization scripts for rapid agent setup
